site.title: Camilo Taba – Laravel & PHP Developer · Web & Mobile
site.description: Laravel & PHP developer building enterprise SaaS, with full-stack web (Vue and TypeScript) and Flutter mobile apps. Based in Alicante, Spain.

home.lead: I build management applications with Laravel: backends, APIs and web dashboards. I also develop mobile apps with Flutter.
home.aria_cv: Open Camilo Taba's CV in a new tab

projects.heading: Projects
projects.intro: Two projects of my own, live in production, that you can try right now.

truekapp.summary: A platform for swapping items without money, with live chat between users and an AI assistant that searches the published listings.
truekapp.detail: It started as my final-year project. I developed the complete application and run it on my own server, with automated tests on every change. You can try it without signing up; the demo resets daily.
truekapp.img_alt: Truekapp chat between two users negotiating a swap
truekapp.note: The code is private; the demo shows the full application.

valodex.summary: A site for browsing Valorant agents, weapons, maps and player stats.
valodex.detail: I rebuilt it from scratch in React from an earlier version in plain JavaScript. Requests to the external APIs go through a small server in between that keeps the key private and respects their rate limits.
valodex.img_alt: Grid of Valorant agents in VALO·DEX

expertise.heading: Areas of expertise
expertise.intro: My work focuses on Laravel and PHP backends, from business logic to APIs. I also build interfaces with JavaScript, TypeScript and Vue, and mobile apps with Flutter.

backend.title: Laravel backends and APIs
backend.body: Business logic, permissions, databases and integrations with other systems.

platforms.title: Management applications and SaaS
platforms.body: Admin panels, reports and multi-tenant applications for organising processes and data.

frontend.title: JavaScript, TypeScript and Vue
frontend.body: Web interfaces connected to the backend for browsing information, managing data and carrying out everyday tasks.

mobile.title: Flutter mobile applications
mobile.body: Apps connected to APIs, with notifications, synchronisation and offline functionality.

frakt24.description: Multi-tenant logistics SaaS for transport companies.
frakt24.highlight1: Built the drivers’ timesheet end to end: an offline-capable Flutter app, approval in Vue and a Laravel backend connected to the digital tachograph and payroll.
frakt24.highlight2: Designed and built per-shipment emissions calculation (CO₂e, NOx, PM, CO and HC) following GLEC v3.2 and aligned with ISO 14083, with every factor traceable to its published source.
frakt24.highlight3: Built route profitability calculations combining fuel consumption, driver salary and overtime.

gesa.description: Sole developer of an AI-powered nutrition app.
gesa.highlight1: Built the Laravel backend: REST API, data model and business logic.
gesa.highlight2: Built the Flutter app, with AI nutrition analysis of photos and PDFs, push notifications and real-time sync.

managepoint.description: Management application for a gaming-venue company.
managepoint.highlight1: Built ManagePoint, which replaced the old system: venues, staff, furniture and terminals in one place.
managepoint.highlight2: Added per-venue work reports and PDF reports, with a change history that only an administrator can correct.
